about_the_game:
Star Gun is a fast-paced, roguelite, auto-scrolling space shooter blending RPG-style progression and procedurally generated levels. Choose your ship, upgrade it to the max, and blast through relentless waves of enemies to free the galaxy—solo or with a friend!

Key Features

  • A New Galaxy Every Time. Every playthrough is a fresh experience. Explore a procedurally generated galaxy map filled with unpredictable missions and enemy formations. No two playthroughs are ever the same—adapt your loadout, rethink your tactics, and prepare for the unexpected each time you take flight.

  • Fly What Fits You. You'll unlock a range of 20 playable ships, each with their own strengths and playstyles. Whether you prefer speed, firepower, or tactical versatility, there’s a ship to match your approach to galactic domination.

  • Progression That Matters. Grow stronger with every mission. Unlock new gear, face escalating challenges, and transform your fragile starter ship into a cosmic powerhouse. Star Gun rewards skillful play and smart upgrades.

  • Deep Ship Customization. Unlock 180 powerful items to tailor your ship to your liking. From devastating weapons and defensive systems to special abilities, build the ultimate loadout to match your strategy and dominate any encounter.

  • Skill-Based Combat. Expect a challenge. Star Gun’s fast-paced combat rewards precision, timing, and mastery of your loadout. It’s tough but never unfair—and each defeat leaves you wiser, stronger, and more prepared.

  • Epic Boss Battles. Face off against 14 unique and formidable bosses, each with distinct attack patterns and mechanics. These intense battles will push your reflexes, strategy, and ship upgrades to their limits.

  • Modern Dodge System. Dodge through enemy fire using invincibility frames in a responsive, soulslike dodge mechanic. Perfect your timing to phase through danger—or even use enemy attacks to your advantage with the right gear. This isn't just evading—it's dancing through chaos.

  • Local Co-op Action. Team up with a friend in local co-op to take on the galaxy together. Coordinate your strategies, combine firepower, and experience the thrill of space combat side by side.
